q1.a: Jasa Proteksi is a platform that offers online insurance products tailored to your lifestyle needs. Jasa Proteksi is licensed and supervised by the Financial Services Authority (OJK) with license number KEP-060/NB.1/2021.

q2.a: Jasa Proteksi offers various insurance product options from the best and most renowned insurers so you don't have to go through a long and complicated process. With just a few clicks, you can be protected through a comfortable, practical process at an affordable price.

q3.q: How do I purchase an insurance product?
q3.a: Select the insurance that suits your needs on the Products page and enter the required data. Once all information is complete, proceed to payment via QRIS, e-wallet, virtual account, or credit card. After successful payment, your insurance policy will be issued immediately.

q4.q: What insurance products are available at Jasa Proteksi?
q4.a: Jasa Proteksi offers: 1) Motorcycle & Electric Motorcycle Insurance, 2) Car & Electric Car Insurance, 3) Travel Insurance (domestic & international), 4) Pet Insurance (dogs & cats), 5) Personal Accident Insurance. All available with affordable premiums and an easy purchase process.

q5.q: Is the claims process at Jasa Proteksi easy?
q5.a: Very easy! Jasa Proteksi offers claims via reimbursement and cashless systems. Claims can be made anytime and anywhere. For assistance, you can contact Jasa Proteksi Customer Service Monday through Friday, 10:00-17:00 WIB.

q6.q: What if the product I want isn't available at Jasa Proteksi?
q6.a: Jasa Proteksi can still help you! Contact our Telesales team by clicking the WhatsApp button on our website. Our team will help you find the right insurance solution for your needs.
